alignment.note: the reproduction is this far from where the original has the same floor

P1.reason: The plans show the same overall shape: two octagonal wings either side of a central light shaft, with a stair block on the far right. The inner partitions differ in several places. The original's north-west and south-west rooms are cut by diagonal walls that the reproduction draws as stepped blocks, and the reproduction's north-east room sits in a different position. The doors and ways between rooms cannot be checked from the pictures, and the func_door pair on the original's upper storey has no matching door marked in the reproduction's storey view.

P2.reason: The walkable floor overlaps at 0.883 with the plans aligned, above the 0.70 line. The only alignment offset is 16 units in height, so the footprints in the plans agree to within a few percent.

P3.reason: The floor heights are close but off by 16 to 32 units at several levels. Storey ceilings read 578 against 556 (ground storey), 372 against 336 (middle storey) and 228 against 196 (upper storey). In the section, the ground floor, the 320 and 512 ledges and the 640 ceilings line up, but the upper ledges and the start heights sit a little lower in the reproduction. The stairs at the far right are in the same place.

P4.reason: 51 of 58 entities match within 64 units (0.879), which passes the measure. Seven are missing or misplaced: ammo_ARgrenades at -664 ±152 336, ammo_buckshot at -208 -184 336, weapon_handgrenade at -560 ±184 336, ammo_gaussclip at -208 184 336, and item_longjump at -72 0 336. The longjump is the one a player would miss most. The reproduction has the same count of entities, so the seven it lacks are placed elsewhere or as other classes.

P5.reason: The reproduction's surfaces are the right kind of grey concrete panel, but they are blotchy and noisy. In START 4 and START 5 to 7 the wall looks like smeared noise where the original has clean panels. The original's bookshelf walls (START 1, 2, 3, 6, 8) are missing entirely from the reproduction's textures. Panel seams are roughly at the right spacing in START 1 and START 2.

P6.reason: The reproduction has far more light entities than the original and they are in the wrong places. The sweep counts 26 light entities in open air against the original's 2, and the storey plans show dozens of LIGHT marks spread across the reproduction where the original has about twenty. In START 8 the original shows a lit fluorescent tube in the corridor ceiling, which the reproduction does not have, and most of the reproduction's views are darker than the original's.

P7.reason: The central light shaft, the two octagonal rooms, the stair block at the far right and the steps on the storeys are all there and in place. The original's distinctive bookshelf corridor (START 1, 2, 3, 8) is missing from the reproduction, and the grating and trim that the original shows in the central shaft are not picked out in the reproduction.

P8.reason: The reproduction compiles (checkErrors is empty) and the walk test reaches every item and way out (0 unreached in the reproduction). The sweep shows the same 48 hurting drops and no glows in mid-air as the original, and no solid in mid-air. The measurements do not report a leak check, so this relies on the empty checkErrors.

P9.reason: From the start points the reproduction keeps the panelled corridor shapes of the original in START 1 and START 2, but the bookshelves that a player would use to recognise the place are missing, and the lighting is too dark in START 3 to 7. START 8 (the corridor with the bookshelves and ceiling light) is the view a player would know best, and in the reproduction it is a dark corridor with no shelves and no light. A player who knows the map would not recognise it at once.
